item.title: From Jensen Huang to Steve Jobs: How tech founders made stunning CEO comebacks
item.description: Nvidia's board reinstated CEO Jensen Huang 11 days later on November 23, 2026, saying that “the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.”

item.title: Nvidia Board decided to reinstate Jensen Huang on Sunday, management was informed at the last minute: Report
item.description: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO in a rapid board reversal, reportedly following pressure from President Donald Trump and investors. The company said it consulted senior US officials, who provided input supporting the view that Huang’s return posed no national security risk.

item.title: From FBI, intelligence probe to antitrust investigation: Here’s a look at several charges that Nvidia, Jensen Huang face
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return has not ended the scrutiny surrounding the chipmaker. From FBI and intelligence inquiries into alleged Chinese links to antitrust, congressional and SEC investigations, the company continues to face multiple probes in the US.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s net worth jumps $34 billion as he returns as Nvidia CEO amid Chinese spy ‘scandal’
item.description: Jensen Huang made a triumphant return to Nvidia's Santa Clara, California, headquarters on Monday.

item.title: ’Jensen! Jensen! Jensen!’: Nvidia employees chant Huang’s name as he makes stunning return as CEO | Watch
item.description: Nvidia employees celebrated Jensen Huang's return as CEO, chanting his name and distributing cupcakes bearing the message “Jensen is back.” However, his reinstatement comes amid questions over the board's handling of the crisis and ongoing investigations into allegations surrounding the chipmaker.

item.title: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia as CEO: How Donald Trump helped engineer the return of a ‘national treasure’
item.description: Nvidia’s board unanimously reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO less than two weeks after his resignation amid allegations of extramarital affairs. President Donald Trump said he had intervened with the board, which concluded Huang’s return posed no national security risk.

item.title: New data centre cable business helps Diamond Power reduce reliance on Adani Group
item.description: The early traction marks a significant step in the Diamond Power’s efforts to diversify beyond the Adani Group, which has dominated its order book.

item.title: Lok Capital raises $130 mn in first tranche of fifth fund, eyes $250 mn at final close
item.description: Lok Capital is deepening its focus in core areas including financial services and climate transition segments

item.title: Tata Steel's 5-million-tonne partner is an APL Apollo promoter family firm with a real estate tag
item.description: Promoter Gupta family, which is selling its stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 crore, will set up 5 mtpa of colour-coated steel capacity for Tata Steel through SG Tech, a company with no operating income in FY25.

item.title: Zscaler’s Chaudhrys to Reap $14.5 Billion From CrowdStrike Deal
item.description: The biggest winners of CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.’s $44 billion acquisition of cybersecurity software maker Zscaler Inc. — by far — are the company’s billionaire founder, Jay Chaudhry, and members of his family, who combined own more than a third of the company’s shares, according to regulatory filings.

item.title: Who is Ankur Singla? Meet Brew TV Founder - Firm launched to fix India’s indie film distribution with 80% filmmaker pay
item.description: After moving from law and tech entrepreneurship into filmmaking, Singla launched Brew TV to address the unpredictable theatrical distribution faced by independent films. His experience releasing Ghich Pich inspired a model combining limited cinema screenings with online access.

item.title: Amazon is 32, but Jeff Bezos once predicted it would go bankrupt. What his 30-year rule means for businesses today
item.description: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos once predicted the company would eventually go bankrupt, warning that even the biggest businesses rarely remain dominant forever. As Amazon turns 32 and ramps up AI spending, his 30-year rule offers lessons on corporate survival and innovation.

item.title: Who is Artemis Patrick? Meet Sephora CEO as she reveals why she once refused to work at the beauty company
item.description: Artemis Patrick eventually joined Sephora in 2006, eight years after turning down the initial offer.

item.title: Who is Jay Chaudhry? Indian-origin entrepreneur behind Zscaler's $43.9 bn deal as CrowdStrike moves to acquire firm
item.description: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at about $43.9 billion. Zscaler shareholders will receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each share they own. The companies say the deal will combine complementary cybersecurity technologies.

item.title: SpiceJet crisis: Why pilots’ body wants govt to curb airline’s flight operations, put ₹5,500-crore fundraise under lens
item.description: The Federation of Indian Pilots has urged the government to curb SpiceJet’s flight operations unless it demonstrates adequate resources to operate safely. The federation has flagged grounded aircraft and delayed salaries and sought scrutiny of the airline’s proposed ₹5,500-crore fundraising.

item.title: Who is Anup Seth, the new TRUST Mutual Fund CEO? All about his career, experience and leadership roles
item.description: His experience across insurance, distribution, digital platforms and retail is expected to play a key role in TRUST Mutual Fund's efforts to broaden its investor base and scale its business.

item.title: APL Apollo's Gupta took less so minority shareholders could get more, but the deal structure waxes off investors
item.description: While heartfelt, the gesture failed to please investors, who dumped shares of both Tata Steel and APL Apollo on Monday. Tata Steel shares fell 8.16%, while APL Apollo Tubes declined 21.39%

item.title: SBI offers up to ₹1.6 crore CTC for Chief AI Officer: Who can apply and what are the roles?
item.description: SBI is offering up to ₹1.6 crore in annual CTC for a Chief AI Officer role, as well as five other AI and technology roles. The top post requires 15 years of experience, including three years in senior leadership. All six positions are contractual, initially for three years.

item.title: Elon Musk says 'mistake has been corrected' as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia; Bill Ackman and others react
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return to the US has triggered mixed reactions. Elon Musk and Bill Ackman have welcomed the development, while Democratic lawmakers have criticised his recent comments and approach to China's chip market.

item.title: Jensen Huang back as NVIDIA CEO: What led to his comeback? 180,000-signature petition, board support and US govt ‘input’
item.description: The board has not attributed its decision to any single factor. Its official explanation centres on Huang's candour, leadership ability and the conclusion that his return poses no national security risk.

item.title: Adani Airports chases fast-growing non-aero revenues with latest $300-mn fund raise
item.description: Adani Airport Holdings raised ₹2,790 crore from 360 ONE Asset, bringing its external equity funding to ₹12,615 crore. The capital will support airport upgrades, city-side developments, and other non-aero revenues as the operator aims at annual passenger capacity of 200 million at eight airports.

item.title: ‘I convinced them’: How Donald Trump reacted to ‘National Treasure’ Jensen Huang’s return as Nvidia CEO
item.description: Trump welcomed Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, calling him a 'Great Patriot and National Treasure'. Trump backed the board's decision, saying Huang's return posed no national security risk and was vital for Nvidia and the US economy.

item.title: Noel Tata's objection pushes Tata Sons board meeting to 30 November
item.description: Tata Sons’ board is set to discuss the company’s mandatory listing, Noel Tata’s objections to the process and proposals to keep the holding company private, amid growing differences within the Tata group.

item.title: Missed Gold Spot? Coca-Cola plans to bring back the iconic orange drink after 26 years with a twist
item.description: The carbonated soft drink is expected to be introduced soon in a low-sugar or zero-sugar variant, keeping in mind changing consumer preferences and the growing demand for healthier beverage options.

item.title: Nvidia brings back Jensen Huang as CEO amid China ‘spy’ affair row | Read full statement
item.description: Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO after board discussions and input from the US government. The board’s investigation into a foreign intelligence effort targeting Huang will continue, while Nvidia strengthens its compliance oversight.

item.title: Jensen Huang reacts after being reinstated as NVIDIA CEO, says ‘I can’t wait to get back to work’
item.description: “I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said in a statement.

item.title: Trump's crypto gala goes from lavish to low-key as $TRUMP token crashes below $1 and investor wealth shrinks
item.description: Sunday's dinner for top $TRUMP meme coin holders at Trump National Golf Club in Virginia was far more subdued than the first gala, which drew wealthy investors in luxury sports cars.

item.title: Nvidia brings Jensen Huang back as CEO after unanimous board vote, Colette Kress returns to CFO role
item.description: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after a unanimous board vote, but investigations into national security concerns will continue.

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, shares surge 31%
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who was fired last week from the top job, has been reinstated, according to a company post on X.

item.title: Rene Haas extends Arm tenure through 2033, takes SoftBank vice chairman role
item.description: Rene Haas has extended his Arm CEO contract through 2033 and will become SoftBank vice chairman, raising questions about Nvidia's search for Jensen Huang's successor.

item.title: RINL teams win three gold awards at ICQCC 2026 in Bangladesh; here's what their projects involved
item.description: Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited (RINL), which operates the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant, won three Gold Awards at ICQCC 2026 in Bangladesh. Three teams from the Blast Furnace, SMS-1 and Utilities departments were recognised for projects aimed at improving plant operations and efficiency.

item.title: Who is Baba Kalyani? Meet the industrialist facing a bitter family battle over ₹1 lakh crore wealth
item.description: The legal battle pits Baba Kalyani against his sister, Sugandha Hiremath, over claims relating to a 1994 family arrangement and the distribution of ancestral wealth.

item.title: Who is Sugandha Hiremath? Meet businesswoman at centre of Kalyani family’s ₹1 lakh crore ancestral wealth dispute
item.description: Sugandha Hiremath's claims reportedly include a transfer of around 34% stake in Hikal Ltd, held by entities controlled by her brother Baba Kalyani.
